configuration.activity_sampling: Independent Bernoulli activity conditioned on at least one active user; receiver gets the conditional marginal, never the true active count.
configuration.paired_design: The same 100 base scene seeds are reused across every SNR and grid mode. Geometry, activity, path gains, base pilots and standardized noise are paired; on-grid rebuilds the physical forward model.
configuration.evaluation_role: First 100 independent Monte Carlo scenes per point with frozen weights and stopping settings; proposed only, baseline comparisons pending.
configuration.runtime_scope: One model load per process, native inference time includes network calls and progress recording; model load, generation and offline truth scoring recorded separately.
configuration.metrics: AER from total errors divided by total user decisions; active/full NMSE from summed error energies divided by summed signal energy. Keep MAX_ITERATIONS, unsupported queries, warning counts and failed attempts.
configuration.snr_selection: User selected -4 through 6 dB; 2 dB spacing follows the existing SNR sweep convention. Fixed before any new receiver evaluation.
